You must answer on the enclosed answer booklet.
You will need: Answer booklet (enclosed)
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
Follow the instructions on the front cover of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper,
ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–18
1 How important were the actions of Britain and France as a reason for the failure of the Schlieffen
Plan? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was Russia’s defeat in 1917 to the course of the war on the Western Front? Explain
your answer.
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–45
How important was the publication of Mein Kampf to the development of the Nazi Party by 1933?
Explain your answer.
How significant was the role of the family in German society under the Nazis? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–41
How important were the personal weaknesses of Tsar Nicholas II as a cause of revolution in 1917?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were the actions of Lenin in establishing Bolshevik rule between 1917 and 1921?
Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY D: THE UNITED STATES, 1919–41
How important was government policy in creating the prosperity of the 1920s in the USA? Explain
your answer.
How significant was the fear of foreigners as a cause of intolerance in US society in the 1920s?
Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important was the unpopularity of the Kuomintang as the reason for its defeat in the Chinese
Civil War? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was industrialisation in changing life in China in the 1950s and 1960s? Explain your
answer.
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important were the changes to the Pass Laws after 1948 to the lives of the non-white population
in South Africa? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were the Soweto riots of June 1976 in weakening the system of apartheid? Explain
your answer.
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was the Second World War to developments in Palestine up to 1949? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant was President Sadat to the improvement of relations between Egypt and Israel
after 1973? Explain your answer. [40]
